intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in Bengaluru, but they sit in different parts of the admission map. This page compares recorded fees, placements, exams and NIRF ranks from our database and public pages opened in {{year}}.

Jain University vs MS Ramaiah Institute of Technology is a choice between a private university school that uses its own JET test, and a long-running VTU-affiliated institute that admits through KCET and COMEDK.

sections.heading: Jain University vs MS Ramaiah Institute of Technology for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose MS Ramaiah Institute of Technology if you want a 2025 NIRF Engineering rank of 75, a KCET or COMEDK route, and the newer recorded placement year on this page.
Choose Jain University's engineering school if you prefer a private university campus and are ready to take JET, knowing that our latest NIRF Engineering row for Jain is from 2022, at rank 115.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Our records list ₹75,000 a year as tuition, and as a year-wise total, for Jain University B.Tech programmes on this page. Treat that as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed four-year total, until you check Jain's current fee notice.

For MS Ramaiah Institute of Technology our records show a year-wise total of ₹1.12 lakh. KCET, COMEDK and management seats often have different fees in Karnataka, so the official circular for your quota is the figure to budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Jain University's latest recorded year here is 2020, with an average package of ₹7 lakh and a highest package of ₹32 lakh. These are historical figures, not a promise for the next batch.
MSRIT's recorded 2023 figures are an average of ₹8 lakh and a highest of ₹50 lakh. The years are not the same, so the two packages should not be read as a head-to-head for one graduating class.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Jain University's engineering admissions on this page are listed through JET, the university's own test. Confirm the current eligibility and any JEE Main pathway on Jain's official admissions page.

MSRIT admits undergraduate engineering students through KCET and COMEDK UGET, as a VTU-affiliated autonomous institute in Bengaluru. Class 12 PCM rules follow the counselling authority for the seat you seek.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Bengaluru, Karnataka. MSRIT is a well-known campus in the Mathikere–MSR Nagar area. Jain University's engineering school is a different campus from MSRIT, so visit both if location inside the city matters to you.
The city is the same; the admission test and the NIRF standing are not.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want the 2025 NIRF Engineering rank, a KCET or COMEDK seat and the later placement year on this page, MS Ramaiah Institute of Technology is the stronger fit.
If you want a private university B.Tech and will take JET, Jain University is the more direct route, though its recorded NIRF Engineering rank here is older and its recorded placement year is 2020.
Confirm each official fee circular for your quota before you compare rupees, because Karnataka counselling seats and university seats are not priced the same way.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Jain University or MSRIT, for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: MSRIT has the newer NIRF 2025 Engineering rank of 75 and a 2023 placement record on this page. Jain University is a private university option through JET, with a 2022 NIRF Engineering rank of 115 in our records and a 2020 placement year.

faqs.question: What are the recorded B.Tech fees for Jain University vs MSRIT?
faqs.answer: Our records list ₹75,000 a year for Jain University and ₹1.12 lakh a year for MSRIT. These are recorded year figures, not confirmed four-year totals. Karnataka KCET and COMEDK fees can differ by quota, so check the official circular.

faqs.question: Which exams do Jain University and MSRIT accept for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: Our records list JET for Jain University, and KCET plus COMEDK UGET for MSRIT. Confirm any additional JEE Main route on the current official admissions pages.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Jain University and MSRIT?
faqs.answer: Jain University's latest recorded year here is 2020, with an average of ₹7 lakh and a highest of ₹32 lakh. MSRIT's 2023 average is ₹8 lakh and the highest is ₹50 lakh. The years are different, so they are not a same-batch comparison.

faqs.question: Are Jain University and MSRIT both in Bengaluru?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both offer B.Tech in Bengaluru, Karnataka, on different campuses. MSRIT is in the Mathikere–MSR Nagar area. Visit both if the exact neighbourhood matters.
